_comment: The headline figure from every finding, in one file, so a number can be had without opening a dataset.

EVERY FIGURE CARRIES ITS LIMIT, in the 'limit' field beside it. A summary is where caveats go to die -- the number survives the trip and the qualification does not -- so quoting a value from here without its limit misreports it.

ONE NUMBER PER FINDING, AND NOTHING CONDITIONAL. Anything by year, state, institution or occupation needs the dataset named in the 'dataset' field; 'path' says where inside it this value came from, so any figure here can be checked against its source in one step.

Non-resident and temporary-visa are visa categories, not birthplaces: naturalised citizens and permanent residents count as domestic, so every such share is a floor on the foreign-born proportion. The one exception is the foreign-born labour figures, which come from the CPS and do include naturalised citizens -- their limits say so.

masters_nra_share_latest.label: Non-resident share of core-STEM master's degrees, 2025
masters_nra_share_latest.limit: A visa category, not a birthplace: naturalised citizens and permanent residents count as domestic, so this is a floor.

masters_nra_share_1995.label: The same share in 1995
masters_nra_share_1995.limit: 1995 and 2025 are consistent on award level 7; the doctorate series crosses the 2008-09 award-level recoding and is built across it.

doctorate_nra_share_latest.label: Non-resident share of core-STEM research doctorates, 2025
doctorate_nra_share_latest.limit: Roughly flat across the post-2010 period. The finding of this project is concentration, not a rising national share.

masters_awarded_latest.label: Core-STEM master's degrees awarded, 2025
masters_awarded_latest.limit: IPEDS counts degrees, not people; one graduate with two majors is counted once, under their first.

gss_foreign_share_latest.label: Temporary-visa share of full-time S&E graduate enrolment, 2024
gss_foreign_share_latest.limit: Science, engineering and health enrolments, which is a different population from the core-STEM degree counts and not comparable with them.

institutions_profiled.label: Institutions on the comparison table
institutions_profiled.limit: An institution appears if it has degrees, enrolment or federal money; fields it has no data for are absent rather than zero.

federal_per_doctorate_median.label: Median federal obligations per core-STEM research doctorate awarded per year
federal_per_doctorate_median.limit: An intensity ratio, not a price. Federal obligations fund research whose outputs include papers, instruments, facilities and staff, not only degrees, and the top of the ranking is medical schools.

majority_foreign_institutions.label: Institutions where a majority of graduate students hold a temporary visa
majority_foreign_institutions.limit: Enrolment on the GSS science-engineering-health basis, matched by name to the R&D survey; unmatched institutions are excluded, not counted as zero.

majority_foreign_federal_rd.label: Federal R&D expenditure at those institutions
majority_foreign_federal_rd.limit: Expenditure recorded at the institution, never at a person. The claim is about where the money and the enrolment coincide, not about who was paid.

below_metro_median_pct.label: Certified H-1B filings promising below the median for their occupation in their own metropolitan area
below_metro_median_pct.limit: The promised wage on the labour condition application, not pay received. Filings that no metropolitan area could be resolved for are excluded.

below_national_median_pct.label: The same comparison against the national occupational median
below_national_median_pct.limit: Lower than the metropolitan figure because filings concentrate in high-cost metros, so the national comparison understates the gap.

eb_adjustment_share_pct.label: Employment-based green cards going to people already in the United States, 2023
eb_adjustment_share_pct.limit: An adjustment of status does not record which visa the person held before it, so this does not trace anyone from a student visa.

foreign_born_share_employment.label: Foreign-born share of all US employment
foreign_born_share_employment.limit: Foreign-born here includes naturalised citizens, so it is a wider group than the visa categories used elsewhere on this site.

foreign_born_share_computing.label: Foreign-born share of computer and mathematical occupations
foreign_born_share_computing.limit: A single year. The occupation split is not yet built as a series, so no trend may be read from it.
